trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State purpose of call and provide reference number.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು property ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳ್ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು. ನನ್ನ reference number LD-1002.

steps.purpose: Greet and prompt for identity verification.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ನಾನು details check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Security purpose ಗೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು confirm ಮಾಡ್ಬೋದಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide name and express time pressure.
steps.text: ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ರಮೇಶ್. ನಂಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ time ಇಲ್ಲ, ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ, cheapest 3BHK ಯಾವುದು ಇದೆ?

steps.purpose: Verify caller identity before disclosing account details.
Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and ask caller to wait.
steps.text: Thank you ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ. ನಾನು ಈಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ details check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು line ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಿ.

steps.purpose: Agree to wait but urge speed.
Look up lead preferences and budget.
Return lead details.
Confirm lead preferences based on CRM data.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ profile ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ನೀವು Pune ನಲ್ಲಿ 3BHK ನೋಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀರಾ, ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ budget 60 lakhs ಇದೆ, ಸರಿನಾ?

steps.purpose: Confirm budget and ask for specific projects.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, 60 lakhs. ಯಾವುದಾದ್ರೂ specific project ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Prompt user for any project they have in mind.
steps.text: ನೀವು ಯಾವುದಾದ್ರೂ specific project ಮನಸ್ಸಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: State preferred project and ask for availability.
steps.text: Pune Heights project ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದ್ದೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ 60 lakhs ಗೆ 3BHK ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ? ಬೇಗ ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the requested project.
Return inventory for Pune Heights.
Inform caller of the price and possession for the requested project.
steps.text: ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ, Pune Heights project, ಇದರ RERA ID PRM/KA/123, ಇಲ್ಲಿ 3BHK unit price 85 lakhs ಇದೆ. ಇದರ possession Q4 2025 ಗೆ ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Express that the price is over budget and ask for alternatives.
steps.text: 85 lakhs? ಅದು ನನ್ನ budget ಗಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ. ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವುದಾದ್ರೂ project ನಲ್ಲಿ 60 lakhs ಗೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Suggest checking an alternative project.
steps.text: ನಾನು ಬೇರೆ projects check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Green Valley project ನಲ್ಲಿ check ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?

steps.purpose: Agree but reiterate time pressure.
steps.text: ಹಾ ಮಾಡಿ, ಆದ್ರೆ ನಂಗೆ meeting start ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇದೆ. Just ಅಲ್ಲಿ price ಎಷ್ಟು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the alternative project.
Return inventory for Green Valley.
Inform caller of the alternative project's price.
steps.text: Green Valley project, RERA ID PRM/KA/456, ಇಲ್ಲಿ 3BHK unit price 75 lakhs ಇದೆ. ಇದು ಕೂಡ ನಿಮ್ಮ 60 lakhs budget ಗಿಂತ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Reject the alternative price and ask for a callback.
steps.text: ಓಹ್, 75 lakhs ಕೂಡ ಜಾಸ್ತಿನೇ. 2BHK ಗೆ ಎಂಥಾ price ಇದೆ? ನಂಗೆ ಈಗ time ಇಲ್ಲ, callback ಮಾಡಿ.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge callback request and ask for a time.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತಾ, ನಾನು 2BHK inventory details ಜೊತೆ ನಿಮಗೆ callback arrange ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ಯಾವ time ಗೆ call ಮಾಡ್ಲಿ?

steps.purpose: Specify callback time.
Confirm callback time and end call.
steps.text: ಸರಿ ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ, 2 hours ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ call ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ. ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.

steps.purpose: End call.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told no matching unit exists and given what does.
